query: For a 92-year-old woman: among female ICU patients aged 87–97 with lower GI bleeding (first ICU stay), stratify by quintiles of distinct procedures in the first 48 hours and report mean procedure count, mean ICU LOS (days), and in-hospital mortality%.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, i.icustay_id, o.operator_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.intime) AS admission_year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.subject_id) AS patient_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.procedure_id) AS procedure_count, AVG(i.length_of_stay) AS average_length_of_stay, SUM(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mortality_count FROM patients p JOIN icustays i ON p.subject_id = i.subject_id JOIN operators o ON i.operator_id = o.operator_id JOIN procedureevents pr ON p.subject_id = pr.subject_id AND i.stay_id = pr.hadm_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.intime) BETWEEN 2017 AND 2018 AND p.anchor_age >= 92 AND p.anchor_age <= 97 AND pr.charttime BETWEEN i.intime AND i.intime + interval '48 hours' AND pr.icd_code IN (SELECT icd_code FROM diagnoses_icd WHERE icd_version = '4') GROUP BY p.gender, i.icustay_id, o.operator_id, admission_year ORDER BY p.gender, i.icustay_id, o.operator_id, admission_year NULLS LAST;
